semantics.clock: All sequential logic updates at positive clk edges, explicitly required by original problem.
semantics.shift: When shift_ena is 1, shift q toward the MSB and insert data at bit 0: four serial bits supplied MSB first form the desired word.
semantics.count: When only count_ena is 1, decrement current q.
semantics.hold: When both enables are 0, retain q.
semantics.simultaneous: Original problem permits any behavior with both enables 1; implementation chooses shift priority.
semantics.reset_initialization: No reset or initial value is specified or provided as a port; no initialization is added. Simulation begins unknown until four known bits have been shifted.

numeric.decrement: Modulo 16, including 0 to 15 wraparound, from four-bit register arithmetic.

verification.oracle: Original problem serial MSB-first loading and mathematical modulo-16 decrement.
verification.sampling: Drive at negative edges; check before positive edges for hold and after positive edges after NBA updates.
verification.coverage: All 16 serially loaded words, all countdown values and wraparound, hold cycles, falling-edge inactivity, and partial shifts.
verification.initial: Observe uninitialized q as unknown before first clock; establish known state through four shifts.
verification.termination: Fatal on mismatch; bounded timeout; PASS only after all checks.

specification_ambiguities.evidence: Original says behavior does not matter
specification_ambiguities.resolution: Shift priority; oracle excludes this unconstrained case.

specification_ambiguities.evidence: Original specifies no reset or initialization
specification_ambiguities.resolution: No hardware initialization; test obtains deterministic state by serial loading.
